artifacts.summary: 7-phase implementation plan for five-primitive propositional refactor covering formula type, ND system, Hilbert axioms, bridge, metalogic, and embeddings

memory_candidates.content: When refactoring a formula inductive type to add new constructors, the safe ordering is: (1) add polymorphic axiom abbrevs and HasAxiom* typeclasses at the Foundations level first (no downstream breakage), (2) add formula constructors (causes cascading breaks), (3) fix ND/proof system files, (4) fix bridge files, (5) fix metalogic, (6) fix embeddings last. Keeping new HasAxiom* typeclasses standalone rather than bundling into MinimalHilbert avoids breaking downstream formula types (Modal/Temporal/Bimodal) that don't yet have the new constructors. External embeddings can use Lukasiewicz encoding as a temporary bridge, though the coherence proof may require sorry if the encoding is only classically equivalent.
